object.name: evi_lpg_buchla
object.digest: Buchla Lowpass Gate emulation for your west coast synthesis fun
object.description: Circuit modelled emulation of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate, unique version of a two-pole Sallen and Key filter, based on 'A Digital Model of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate' by Julian Parker and Stefano DAngelo, 2013. In evieve this is all audio rate inputs to control the voltage input to the gate, with additional features such as extra feedback resistors (@boom) and refactored code for optimal CPU usage. The code in this abstraction can be used entirely inside gen~ / GenExpr with internal oversampling (@localresample) and <o>evi_control_lpg_buchla</o>.gendsp for voltage control of Rf (frequency). See <o>evi.lpg~</o> for a wrapped MSP abstraction version.

inlets.name: frequency
inlets.digest: Frequency voltage, typically fed from 'evi_controlcircuit_buchla' or better from 'evi_control_lpg_buchla'.

inlets.name: resonance
inlets.digest: Filter resonance. Effect depends on other settings, such as @boom, @lpg and @vca.

outlets.name: something
outlets.digest: Only if 1x sampling is selected (otherwise zero): quirky bandpass version of the gate.

outlets.name: something
outlets.digest: Only if 1x sampling is selected (otherwise zero): quirky highpass version of the gate.

attributes.name: boom
attributes.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Only has effect if the 'lpg' attribute is on (> 1). Smoothly crossfades additional resistors into the feedback path while maintaining filter stability. This can have a drastic effect on the tone of the filter and the resonance behaviour.

attributes.name: controlres
attributes.description: If on (1), resonance is no longer controlled by inlet 3 and is instead controlled by the @resonance parameter. Default off.

attributes.name: controlrf
attributes.description: If on (1), Rf (frequency) is no longer controlled by inlet 2 and is instead controlled by the @rf parameter. Default off, on would be atypical behaviour.

attributes.name: localresample
attributes.description: Oversampling factor. evi_lpg_buchla should always be oversampled for normal usage. 0 = 1x, 1 = 2x, 2 = 3x, 3 = 4x (default), 4 = 6x, 5 = 8x.

attributes.name: lpg
attributes.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Smoothly switch or interpolate between filter and gate behaviour.

attributes.name: nonlin
attributes.description: Turning this off is atypical behaviour. On (the default) engages the nonlinearities in the filter/gate structure. However, it can be very interesting triggering it linearly, but if you do so be careful of overall gain. 0 = linear (1x & 2x oversampling only), 0/1 = tanh (default), 2 = cubic.

attributes.name: resonance
attributes.description: Only if @controlres == 1: parameter rate control of resonance instead of inlet 3. Smoothing time set with @smooth attribute.

attributes.name: rf
attributes.description: Only if @controlrf == 1: parameter rate control of Rf voltage (frequency) instead of inlet 2. Smoothing time set with @rfsmooth and @rfhz attributes.

attributes.name: rfhz
attributes.description: Hz component of the 'rfsmooth' function. You will almost never want 'rfsmooth' to be on (@rfsmooth > 0), especially if driving from 'evi_controlcircuit_buchla.gendsp'.

attributes.name: rfsmooth
attributes.description: ms component of the 'rfsmooth' function. You will almost never want 'rfsmooth' to be on (> 0), especially if driving from 'evi_controlcircuit_buchla.gendsp'.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smoothing time in ms for the 'vca' and 'res' controls (if selected).

attributes.name: vca
attributes.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Smoothly switch or interpolate between LPG and VCA behaviour. Using the block as a pure VCA is useful but far less fun. Ultimately this can be thought of as a gate damping effect, darkening the tone. Smoothing time set with @smooth attribute.
